_comment: Generator definitions for this run. Wrappers for tools without CycloneDX output are in harness/.

tools.name: cdxgen
tools.notes: Arguments mirror BF-CBOM's cdxgen worker. Records source files in properties[].SrcFile without line numbers. Invoked through the pinned image ghcr.io/cyclonedx/cdxgen:12.8.2, so it needs no build root and runs the same on any host with Docker.

tools.name: pqprobe-static
tools.notes: Exit 1 means findings present, not failure. The binary path comes from PQPROBE_STATIC_BIN; the manifest records what it resolved to and that file's sha256. Maintained by the same party as Proofstein; see the governance section in README.md.

tools.name: cryptoscan
tools.notes: Defaults. Withholds findings it classes as quantum-safe (AES, SHA-2). Exits 1 when a critical finding is present, after writing the full report (internal/cli/scan.go at v1.4.0).

tools.name: cryptoscan-quantum-safe
tools.notes: --include-quantum-safe: also reports AES and SHA-2. Exits 1 when a critical finding is present, after writing the full report (internal/cli/scan.go at v1.4.0).

tools.name: cbomkit-theia
tools.notes: Default plugins. Reads certificates, keys, java.security and OpenSSL configuration; no source code.

tools.name: opengrep
tools.package_version: opengrep 1.30.1 with the 100 cryptography rules (harness/select_rules.py, by CWE) of opengrep-rules at f1d2b562, rule content of 0f5a85ce (2024-12-13); rule set sha256/16 58291c511806239d
tools.notes: Each result is a component named by its rule id, at the reported file and line.

tools.name: codeql
tools.package_version: CodeQL bundle 2.27.1 (checksum verified), inventory queries only
tools.notes: Inventory queries for C/C++, Python and Java, every one of those languages present in a project, build-mode none; a project with none of them gets no document.
